title: Stabilize viewer canvas resizing and WebGL context recovery
description: Stabilize viewer canvas resizing and WebGL context recovery
acceptance_criteria: Resize notifications defer and coalesce redraws without ResizeObserver errors; Slice Fit and 16x scrolling/editing keep a bounded visible bitmap; real WebGL loss pauses GPU work until restoration, then restores geometry and the preserved camera/source/slice; site imports the exact tested revision.
